form:FormGroup.label: Kind
form:FormGroup.helpText: What this step asks. Chain picks the elements; Split settles what one record is; Target settles what the events should look like; Configure writes one element's configuration.

form:FormGroup.label: Role
form:FormGroup.helpText: Which elements a Configure step configures: the parser, the transform, or — left empty — every element in chain order. Only a Configure step takes one.

form:FormGroup.label: When
form:FormGroup.helpText: The guard: the step runs only for input of this kind. 'always' runs it for every input.

form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: The step's name for a transition to go to. A word: a letter, then letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Leave it empty and the step goes by its kind.

form:FormGroup.label: Candidates
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many answers to ask for at this step before it is spent. Empty for the kind's own default.

form:FormGroup.label: Kinds
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many kinds of record to show the model at this step. Empty for the kind's own default.

form:FormGroup.label: Checks
form:FormGroup.helpText: What judges this step's answers, and so which outcomes it can raise. None ticked leaves the kind's own checks.

form:FormGroup.label: Transitions
form:FormGroup.helpText: Where the step goes on an outcome. With none it re-asks itself on a shortfall until its candidates are gone, and a pass goes to the next step.
